name: fld_cbrt_two_not_in_Q_sqrt_two
statement: (x : ℝ) (hx : x ^ 3 = 2) (a b : ℚ) : x ≠ (a : ℝ) + (b : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2
closed: ∀ (x : ℝ) (hx : x ^ 3 = 2) (a b : ℚ), x ≠ (a : ℝ) + (b : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2
informal: The cube root of 2 does not lie in ℚ(√2) — expand (a + b√2)^3 = (a^3 + 6ab^2) + (3a^2 b + 2b^3)√2 = 2; irrationality of √2 forces b(3a^2 + 2b^2) = 0, so b = 0 and a^3 = 2; Uses Mathlib2.alg_rat_pow_ne_two at this last step.
